تستخرجوا (form X)
# تَسْتَخْرِجُوا (tastaḵrijū) /tas.tax.ri.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
# تُسْتَخْرَجُوا (tustaḵrajū) /tus.tax.ra.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
